prompt:
A web console screen for an autonomous software factory, seen whole at
1440×900, desktop. The top bar is decided and fixed: one 44 px strip between
two 1 px hairline rules, quiet small-capitals words, no boxes or pills
around links. Left to right: "FACTORY CONSOLE" (the product name, slightly
heavier), the project select "ai-software-factory-code ▾", then the one
bordered word "New task"; a wide gap; the figures group "COSTS · RESOURCES";
a wide gap; the running group "SETTINGS · POLICY · NOTIFICATIONS"; at the
right a moon icon, "sebastian", "LOG OUT". No bar word is colored on this
screen.

Below the bar, the screen fills the rest: the board of work cards on the
left, the agent chat docked at the right edge, and at the very bottom one
thin status strip with its detail panel OPEN above it (the panel is part of
this design; it must be visible and complete).

The chat's thread list is UNFOLDED (its switcher open, showing the threads
as rows inside the chat), and the composer holds a message being typed over
several lines. A tooltip is visible on one of the chat's window controls,
showing how the controls explain themselves.

The screen's exact content, and nothing more — do not invent rows, cards,
sections, numbers, badges, filters, pagination or charts. Only the content
between the CONTENT markers. All text must be crisp and legible, spelled
exactly as given.
DESIGN DIRECTION 7 — QUIET UNTIL TOUCHED. The screen shows nothing it does
not need at rest. The chat's head is only its title and the muted
"project agent · ai-software-factory-code"; its controls appear on hover as
a small quiet cluster at the head's right — an expand glyph, a thread
glyph, tooltips on each ("Chat across the whole screen — the board hides",
"Your threads"); once the chat is full screen the collapse glyph STAYS
visible (quiet is not a trap). The border between board and chat is a bare
hairline that grows a grip on hover, tooltip "Drag to resize". The
composer grows with the message to a third of the screen, then scrolls; no
control. The chat's floor is 24 rem; the unfolded threads table is the
quietest thing on the screen — hairline rows, mono, one amber mark lamp
where a thread waits on you. The open status panel compresses to near
silence: the spend gauges; ONE line "model gateway up · GitHub
sf/ai-software-factory · configuration 4f2c9e1"; and the dependencies as
five green lamps with names, nothing else — no ages, no detail, all on
hover; a down service is the only thing allowed to be loud, red with its
age inline. The discipline: rest state shows state only; every detail is
one hover away; nothing blinks.
CONTENT — the main screen of project ai-software-factory-code, busy.

TOP BAR (fixed): "FACTORY CONSOLE" · "ai-software-factory-code ▾" · the
bordered word "New task" · gap · "COSTS  RESOURCES" · gap ·
"SETTINGS  POLICY  NOTIFICATIONS" · at the right a moon glyph ·
"sebastian" · "LOG OUT".

BOARD, five columns on a panel ground, hairline-ruled cards:
Column 1, header lit amber "NEEDS YOU 3": card "#1124 Merge PR #1126 · low
risk · ◷ 12 min"; card "#1121 Plan, revision 2 · Accept plan · Request
changes"; card "#1108 Stuck on the flaky acceptance test · answers as
buttons: Retry · Answer in your words".
Column 2 "CODING 2": card "#1127 the deps dot goes always-on green ·
writing · 18 min"; card "#1128 documents in the conversation · planning".
Column 3 "VERIFYING 1": card "#1125 the title count is honest · checks 14
green".
Column 4 "WAITING 4": cards "#1119 stalled on the provider · backoff 60 s"
(amber), "#1120 waiting on a human", "#1112 routine · next in 3 h", "#1110
waiting on #1108".
Column 5 "DONE 12" folded to a quiet list: "#1123 …", "#1122 …".

CHAT, docked right: head "Chat  ·  project agent · ai-software-factory-code"
with the controls the direction defines at its right. Thread list unfolded
(the direction decides where it lives), three rows in small mono:
"● | the dependency health light | 2 h"
"· | documents in the conversation | 14 min"
"· | #1124 merge words | yesterday"
Conversation: the agent's message "PR #1126 is green: 14 checks, the model
review found nothing. The diff touches only the dot's colour. Low risk."
then a proposal card "Adopt PR #1126 — merge it as you, close its card"
with a "Do it" button; then your message being typed in the composer, four
lines: "before we merge: does the dot also / show up on the phone view? /
and while you are in there, count / the title words honestly too".
Under the composer the quiet command row "/ask  /tell  /move  /fund" and
the autonomy control "level: working".

STATUS STRIP, the screen's bottom line, cells left to right: "● working" ·
"2 working" · "3 need you" (amber) · "€1.20 / €5.00" with a thin gauge at
24% · "● dependencies" (green dot). The detail panel OPEN above the strip
(the direction decides its shape): spend gauges "today €0.12 of €0.50 day
cap" and "this month €1.20 of €5.00"; the readout line the direction
defines over "model gateway", "GitHub sf/ai-software-factory-code",
"configuration 88928af"; the dependencies forgejo, object storage,
postgres, provider api, temporal, all up, each "under a minute ago" —
compressed the way the direction decides, with the one tooltip the shell
asks for visible on a window control.

END OF CONTENT.
PALETTE (light): page background #f1ece0 (warm paper), no page gradient;
panel surfaces #faf6ec; hairline rules #d8cfba (1 px); text #0f1d33; muted
text #5d6b80; faint text #7a8698; teal #0a6a80 for links, the composer's
prompt mark and the chat panel's top inset rule, sparingly; green #1e7a46
for up/working lamps; burnt amber #8a4f00 only where attention is needed
(the needs-you column's lit header, waiting states), sparingly; red #a03030
for down only. Words in a 13 px humanist sans; every figure, ID, time and
thread name in a tabular monospace. Dense but calm: a mission-control
readout, not a marketing page. Rendered at 1440×900, desktop.
label: 10 quiet-hover light
